newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea yields end lower on improved prospects.
newsitem.headline: South Korea yields end lower on improved prospects.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed lower for the fourth consecutive day on Friday as investors bought actively on better market prospects, traders said.
They said although the central Bank of Korea absorbed one trillion won from the banking system through repurchase agreements (repos), the sentiment remained bullish.
Traders saw the yields moving in a range of 12.55 to 12.75 percent next week.
Three-month CD yields and overnight call rates also fell on improved liquidity conditions.
